messages:
zoe: FYI planning a partial unpin tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Runtime 3.4 -> 3.5 for most routes. Need an emergency opt-in pin for customers on on-prem SDK 1.x that rely on legacy bindings.

adrian: Can we do account-level pins rather than route-wide? Might be less disruptive for Dedicated customers.

zoe: Yes, infra supports account-level pins. Proposal: opt-in pin for accounts flagged 'legacy-binding'. We'll keep embed pinned globally for 48h while we monitor evals.

qa-bot: Ran a quick preflight on canary subset. Embedding similarity tests showed a small but noticeable cosine shift for multilingual corpus on 3.5. Will post detailed numbers.

deploybot: Change window scheduled at 1729999999 (02:00 UTC). Canary cohort can-ml-11: 7% traffic for 20m. Roll plan: 7% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m holds.

ops-bot: Rollback criteria: error >1% for 5m OR embedding-similarity-drop >1.0% on eval monitors -> immediate rollback + sticky-account-pin. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

support: We need a short customer-facing playbook. If a customer reports degraded multilingual embed quality we should offer to opt them into account-level pin to 3.4 immediately. Drafting now.

zoe: Also adding telemetry tag "client_binding" and "sdk_major" so we can correlate. SDK team please make sure clients send this header.

sdk-team: Will cut a small agent patch to add client_binding header to nightly. ETA before rollout.

deploybot: Canary metrics @18m: global error 0.18%, p95 +8%. Embedding sim probe: multilingual set drift 1.2% for canary hostnames.

adrian: That's above our embedding threshold. Can we narrow the canary to non-multilingual hostnames and re-run? Or enable a mitigation in runtime to preserve older tokenization path?

zoe: Two mitigation options: 1) revert canary and keep embed pinned globally (safe), 2) enable compat-tokenizer flag on canary to try preserving semantics. Which do we prefer?

ops-bot: Compat-tokenizer flag exists but is experimental. If we enable it we should run a 30m smoke and keep sticky-account-pin ready.

qa-bot: Compat-tokenizer smoke test on small subset shows drift reduced to 0.3% on multilingual set. Would still like extended 1h validation.

deploybot: Enabling compat-tokenizer on can-ml-11 now. Re-run for 30m.

deploybot: Re-run metrics: errors 0.12%, embed drift 0.35%.

adrian: Good. Recommend proceeding but keep embed pinned globally for 48h and enable account-level opt-in pin for legacy customers. Also notify Dedicated contacts.

support: Playbook updated: how to opt an account to runtime 3.4 pin, expected timeline, and escalation steps. URL: https://redwood.corp/support/runbooks/account-pin.

zoe: Decision summary:
- Proceed with rollout of runtime 3.5 for generate/chat across hosts (canary -> 30% -> full) using compat-tokenizer mitigation enabled for multilingual cohort.
- Global embed route pinned to 3.4 for 48h.
- Account-level opt-in pin for customers with legacy-binding enabled and support playbook published.
- Rollback triggers: errors >1% for 5m OR embedding-similarity-drop >1.0% on eval monitors. Ops will sticky-pin accounts automatically on alert.

sdk-team: Nightly build will include client_binding header. Will post PR and changelog note.

deploybot: 30% rollout started. Will schedule final ramp in 4h if metrics stable.

qa-bot: Opening follow-ups: INF-6201 (expand multilingual eval set), INF-6202 (add account-pin audit logs), INF-6203 (e2e embedding-diff test between runtimes).

adrian: Please also add a changelog blurb for Dedicated customers noting account-level pins and the compat-tokenizer option.

zoe: Will draft consolidated release note and email to Dedicated. Closing coordination thread; ping here for any regression alerts.
